period_end: 2026-11-20 for historical PnL, later real-time quotes and paper forecasts explicitly dated
notes: Tables contain parallel scenarios, not additive PnLs. Dollar gains on actual simulated collateral including cash. Null values indicate missing quotes, incomplete liquidation or unpriced financing. Positive-factor=0.5 halves positive coupons only. Cost=2 doubles exchange fees and assumed adverse slippage. Calendar margin is a conservative hour stress, separate from actual minute audit.

weekly_chain_evidence.units: USDT unless Kraken/USD or an explicitly named native coin
weekly_chain_evidence.rule: Independent native data; actual weekly rule requires both 28d medians per block to exceed earlier 84d medians, prior Friday inclusive. Each qualified asset receives exactly one sixth of the 3000 USDT chain spot wallet. No leverage in spot; total independent allocation remains 10000.

source_evidence.vendor_vs_chain: Finalized chain data and contemporaneously published vendor objects are separate evidence.

weekly_chain_evidence.quarter_definition: Calendar UTC quarter equity returns. Q4 2026 ends November 20, and partial initial periods are included. Weakest two individually listed plus compounded rate; best-two removal separately reported in starting-capital USDT.

future_two_weeks.assumptions: For unrevealed complete days each per-block activity and native fee may range independently from zero to infinity. Exact rational bounds use monotone sample medians. No realized orders or returns in either upcoming week.

controls_15weeks.phase: Original wallet starts 2025-01-01, compare equity from 2026-05-31 close until 2026-11-20 planned exit
controls_15weeks.sample_limit: 15 occupied asset-weeks comprise two nonoverlapping risk episodes and one crypto cycle. Circular/permutation fractions use this finite history and are descriptive, not IID trade p-values.

nonwrapping_episode_controls.design: Post-observation duration-preserving nonwrapping check, sample has only two risk episodes.

forward.status: paper protocols only, never sent an order

quarterly.wallets: three fixed equal 1/3 wallets; each wallet has separate cash spot / perp cash ledger; no automatic transfers
quarterly.guard: classic realized FIFO: marked short >1.75x actual outstanding short fill cost or margin threshold; completed hourly observation, wait next full hour before starting matched liquidation; stay out through quarter; match recorded market participation, lots, fees, funding, dust and missed fills
quarterly.outcomes: Record every calendar separately, own capital after fees, 2x costs plus 0.5 positive-funding and historical spot debt. Mark failures from actual pre/post-fill minute if available, retain conservative stress bounds separately. Compare same dates with cash and lower-risk fixed controls, no backfilling.

paid_funding_filter.rule: 3 prior matured +48h monthly books, >=2 positive after actual proxy spot financing. Each of 3 independent 4000 wallets can dedicate 3333.33 to planned 35% cash-and-carry book; retain idle cash and cash benchmark. Execution begins following clock. Historical results of new interval cannot be credited before maturity.
